channel.title: Plugin on Athian Games
channel.description: Recent content in Plugin on Athian Games

item.title: Procedural Vortex Tunnel
item.description: Procedural Vortex Tunnel is a plugin that lets you build a customizable Vortex Tunnel along a given Spline path procedurally through predefined sets of parameters.

item.title: Art Of Shader - Film And Special Effects
item.description: Give your scene a unique look and style with the customizable Post Process Materials, with tweakable parameters and granular level of controls letting you customize the materials to suit your style, seperate objects in your scene, or your background environent, with different shaders, and even combine multiple shaders to get the effect you are looking for.

item.title: Art Of Shader - Distortion And Glitches
item.description: AOS - Distortion And Glitches is a pack of 40 Customizable Shaders, that can be used in Post Process Blendable Materials , Niagara FX, as well as Mesh Materials to create a variety of distorted and glitched effect to your actors and scenes.

item.title: Art Of Shader - Stylized Post Process
item.description: Give your scene a unique look and style with the customizable Post Process Materials, with tweakable parameters and granular level of controls letting you customize the materials to suit your style, separate objects in your scene, or your background environment, with different shaders, and even combine multiple shaders to get the effect you are looking for.

item.title: Framecapture - Screen Capture and Video Recorder
item.description: Overview framecapture is a C++ based library which lets you take snapshot of your game viewport at desired resolution, and record your in-game screen.

item.title: PostgreSQL Integration for Unreal Engine 4
item.description: Easily execute queries from Blueprints to store and retrieve data from your database.

item.title: MSSQL Integration for Unreal Engine 4
item.description: Easily execute queries from Blueprints to store and retrieve data from your database.

item.title: MySQL Integration for Unreal Engine 4
item.description: Build your own queries and select and update data to your database directly from Blueprints.

item.title: Minimap, Map And Navigation System
item.description: Forget dealing with the limitations of RenderTargets to design your Minimaps, which are performance heavy for larger worlds.

item.title: Runtime FBX Import for Unreal Engine 4
item.description: Features Asynchronously Import FBX files in runtime.
